answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 23878 Country: India Title: Reciting surah fatiha with imam is valid or not? Question: reciting surah fatiha with imam is valid or not Answer ID: 23878 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1109/848/L=1431) It is not right to recite Surah Fatiha behind Imam. The holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: من كان له إمام فقراءة الإمام له قراءة ( او كما قال عليه السلام). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
